text:
You need a highly organized virtual assistant who can keep your real estate business, recruiting goals, and personal planning moving forward every day.

I’m Mina Castellan, and with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization, I bring a detail-focused, process-driven approach to managing busy workflows. I’m comfortable working in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets, and I can support you with tracking leads, maintaining CRM-related information, organizing content calendars, managing lists, and keeping communication tasks consistent and accurate. I’m also strong at turning scattered information into clear, actionable systems that save time.

I’d be glad to support both your business and personal priorities with reliability and structure. Which of the listed tasks is the highest priority for you to delegate first?
